system: Wild & Wandering PMS Backlog & Feature Registry

features.title: Smart Status Validation Warnings on Save
features.description: Trigger non-blocking confirmation dialogs when status conflicts with dates: 'HERE' but check-in is in the future; 'FUTURE' but check-in is in the past; 'TOCHARGE' but balance due is 0.

features.title: Consecutive Stay Back-to-Back Auto-Merge Detector
features.description: Detect when a guest has two back-to-back reservations (Leg 1 check-out == Leg 2 check-in) and present a one-click 'Merge Consecutive Bookings' prompt in the folio header.

features.title: Itemized Nightly Rate Ledger Breakdown
features.description: Expand the Total Price input into an optional day-by-day rate table showing the exact rate applied for each night (standard rate, weekend markup, FMP peak rate).

features.title: Housekeeping & Bed Cleanliness State Matrix
features.description: Add clean/dirty/inspected toggle states to bed rows on the calendar grid, updating automatically when a booking status cycles to 'LEFT'.

features.title: Configurable Event Shoulder Ranges
features.description: Allow properties in Setup Wizard Step 4 to configure custom event shoulder ranges (±1, ±2, or ±3 days) for timeline highlight shading and pricing curves.

features.title: Seasonal Dorm Capacity Switcher
features.description: One-click toggle in Setup Wizard to deactivate upper dorm bunks for low-season (e.g. 8-bed to 6-bed), reducing OTA Channex availability automatically while keeping historical bookings safely mapped.

features.title: Smart Email Communication Engine
features.description: Convert manual email status pills (SENT, FMP?, SPECIAL) into an integrated templating engine that generates personalized confirmation emails based on dates, source OTA, and room type.
